CLIPTextEncode.description: Encodes a text prompt using a CLIP model into an embedding that can be used to guide the diffusion model towards generating specific images.

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model used for encoding the text.

CLIPTextEncode.name: CLIPTextEncode
output_tooltips: A conditioning containing the embedded text used to guide the diffusion model.

CheckpointLoaderSimple.description: Loads a diffusion model checkpoint, diffusion models are used to denoise latents.

ckpt_name.tooltip: The name of the checkpoint (model) to load.

CheckpointLoaderSimple.name: CheckpointLoaderSimple
output_tooltips: The model used for denoising latents.
The CLIP model used for encoding text prompts.
The VAE model used for encoding and decoding images to and from latent space.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent images in the batch.

EmptyLatentImage.description: Create a new batch of empty latent images to be denoised via sampling.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent images in the batch.

height.tooltip: The height of the latent images in pixels.

width.tooltip: The width of the latent images in pixels.

EmptyLatentImage.name: EmptyLatentImage

trimesh.tooltip: Input mesh or pointcloud to normalize

target_size.tooltip: Target bounding box size. 1.0 = [-0.5, 0.5] box (default for TripoSF)

KSampler.description: Uses the provided model, positive and negative conditioning to denoise the latent image.

cfg.tooltip: The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will negatively impact quality.

denoise.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

model.tooltip: The model used for denoising the input latent.

negative.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image.

positive.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image.

sampler_name.tooltip: The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output.

scheduler.tooltip: The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image.

seed.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

steps.tooltip: The number of steps used in the denoising process.

KSampler.name: KSampler

attn_backend.tooltip: Attention backend. auto: best available (sageattn > flash_attn > xformers > sdpa).

precision.tooltip: Model precision. auto: best for your GPU (bf16 on Ampere+, fp16 on Volta/Turing, fp32 on older).

LoraLoader.description: This LoRA loader is used to modify both diffusion and CLIP models, altering the way in which latents are denoised such as applying styles. Multiple LoRA nodes can be linked together.

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model the LoRA will be applied to.

model.tooltip: The diffusion model the LoRA will be applied to.

strength_clip.tooltip: How strongly to modify the CLIP model. This value can be negative.

strength_model.tooltip: How strongly to modify the diffusion model. This value can be negative.

LoraLoader.name: LoraLoader

Preview3D.description: Preview a 3D model file without saving it to the ComfyUI output directory.
Preview3D.name: Preview3D

SaveImage.description: Saves the input images to your ComfyUI output directory.

filename_prefix.tooltip: The prefix for the file to save. This may include formatting information such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd% or %Empty Latent Image.width% to include values from nodes.

SaveImage.name: SaveImage

Tencent3DPartNode.description: Automatically perform component identification and generation based on the model structure.

model_3d.tooltip: 3D model in FBX format. Model should have less than 30000 faces.

seed.tooltip: Seed controls whether the node should re-run; results are non-deterministic regardless of seed.

Tencent3DPartNode.name: Tencent3DPartNode

resolution.tooltip: Encoding grid resolution. Higher = more detail but slower. 1024 recommended.

model_config.tooltip: Model config from Load TRELLIS.2 Models node

max_tokens.tooltip: Max tokens for 1024 cascade. Lower = less VRAM but potentially lower quality. Default 49152 (~9GB), try 32768 (~7GB) or 24576 (~6GB) for lower VRAM.

shape_guidance_rescale.tooltip: Shape guidance rescale. Reduces artifacts from high CFG

shape_guidance_strength.tooltip: Shape CFG scale. Higher = stronger adherence to input image

shape_sampling_steps.tooltip: Shape sampling steps. More steps = better quality but slower

ss_guidance_rescale.tooltip: Sparse structure guidance rescale. Reduces artifacts from high CFG

ss_guidance_strength.tooltip: Sparse structure CFG scale. Higher = stronger adherence to input image

ss_sampling_steps.tooltip: Sparse structure sampling steps. More steps = better quality but slower

conditioning.tooltip: Image conditioning from Get Conditioning node

model_config.tooltip: Model config from Load TRELLIS.2 Models node

mesh_path.tooltip: Absolute path to mesh file (GLB, OBJ, PLY, STL, etc.)

blend_temperature.tooltip: Softmax temperature for view blending. Higher = sharper transitions between views.

front_axis.tooltip: Which 3D axis the front view faces. Z for most models.

max_tokens.tooltip: Max tokens for cascade. Lower = less VRAM.

model_config.tooltip: Model config from Load TRELLIS.2 Models node

floater_threshold.tooltip: Area threshold for removing small disconnected components. 0 = disabled.

original_mesh.tooltip: Original mesh (pre-simplification) for BVH projection. Improves texture accuracy by projecting texel positions back to the original surface.

tex_guidance_rescale.tooltip: Texture guidance rescale. Reduces artifacts from high CFG

tex_guidance_strength.tooltip: Texture CFG scale. Higher = stronger adherence to input image

tex_sampling_steps.tooltip: Texture sampling steps. More steps = better quality but slower

conditioning.tooltip: Image conditioning from Get Conditioning node (same as used for shape)

model_config.tooltip: Model config from Load TRELLIS.2 Models node

shape_slat.tooltip: Shape structured latent from Image to Shape node

subs.tooltip: Subdivision guides from Image to Shape node

tex_guidance_rescale.tooltip: Texture guidance rescale. Reduces artifacts from high CFG

tex_guidance_strength.tooltip: Texture CFG scale. Higher = stronger adherence to input image

conditioning.tooltip: Image conditioning from Get Conditioning node (the new texture reference)

model_config.tooltip: Model config from Load TRELLIS.2 Models node

shape_latent.tooltip: Encoded shape latent from Encode Mesh node

UltimateSDUpscale.description: Upscales an image and runs image-to-image on tiles from the input image.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of tiles to process in a batch. Higher values can reduce processing time but use more VRAM. Yields different results than individual tiles. Only affects the main redraw step, not the seam fix step.

cfg.tooltip: The CFG scale to use for each tile.

denoise.tooltip: The denoising strength to use for each tile.

force_uniform_tiles.tooltip: Force all tiles to be the same as the set tile size, even when tiles could be smaller. This can help prevent the model from working with irregular tile sizes.

mask_blur.tooltip: The blur radius for the mask.

mode_type.tooltip: The tiling order to use for the redraw step.

model.tooltip: The model to use for image-to-image.

negative.tooltip: The negative conditioning for each tile.

positive.tooltip: The positive conditioning for each tile.

sampler_name.tooltip: The sampler to use for each tile.

scheduler.tooltip: The scheduler to use for each tile.

seam_fix_denoise.tooltip: The denoising strength to use for the seam fix.

seam_fix_mask_blur.tooltip: The blur radius for the seam fix mask.

seam_fix_mode.tooltip: The seam fix mode to use.

seam_fix_padding.tooltip: The padding to apply for the seam fix tiles.

seam_fix_width.tooltip: The width of the bands used for the Band Pass seam fix mode.

seed.tooltip: The seed to use for image-to-image.

steps.tooltip: The number of steps to use for each tile.

tile_padding.tooltip: The padding to apply between tiles.

tiled_decode.tooltip: Whether to use tiled decoding when decoding tiles.

upscale_by.tooltip: The factor to upscale the image by.

upscale_model.tooltip: The upscaler model for upscaling the image.

vae.tooltip: The VAE model to use for tiles.

UltimateSDUpscale.name: UltimateSDUpscale

VAEDecode.description: Decodes latent images back into pixel space images.

vae.tooltip: The VAE model used for decoding the latent.

VAEDecode.name: VAEDecode

VoxelToMesh.description: Converts a voxel grid to a mesh.
VoxelToMesh.name: VoxelToMesh
